d: Long, honey-blonde hair is styled with long bangs and two thick braids falling over the shoulders, tied at the ends with white fluffy pom-poms. The eyes are a vivid ruby red with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a white collared shirt paired with a red and white checkered bow, a grey sleeveless jumper dress with white trim, and a dark navy long-sleeved undershirt. A large, olive-drab metallic mechanical device is positioned behind the back.
